Class ReichenbachSink

java.lang.Object
org.roux.ReichenbachSink
final class ReichenbachSink extends Object
The ReichenbachSink selects which turns fit inside a token allowance. The result order is the system pin, then the packed head, then the tail that fits, then the live line. A refused selection returns null. The type holds no region and writes no page. The type refuses construction. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#ReichenbachSink reichenbach-sink.draft.001.md

  • Method Details

    • select

      static ReichenbachSink.Transcript select(int managedTokens, ReichenbachSink.Piece[] pieces)
      The method selects the pieces that fit in a token allowance. An allowance of zero or less returns null. A null piece array returns null. An empty piece array returns null. An array with no piece whose head flag is true returns null. A null piece is skipped. A piece whose live flag is true, or whose message id is 0, is the live line. The last such piece is kept when more than one is present. The stored pieces are sorted by message id, then by ordinal. The pin starts as the leading run of Role.SYSTEM pieces. An empty leading run uses the last system piece instead. A piece whose stay flag is true is added when its ordinal is not already in the pin. The pin is sorted again by message id, then by ordinal. The head holds every remaining piece whose head flag is true. The headOver flag is true when the pin tokens plus the head tokens exceed the allowance. The live line is not included in that comparison. A true headOver flag leaves the tail empty. Otherwise the tail is filled from the end of the stored pieces. An assistant piece takes the previous piece when the message ids are adjacent and that role is Role.USER, Role.TOOL, or Role.TOOL_CALL. A piece already in the pin or the head is skipped. The charged total starts as the pin, the head, and the live line. An atom is added only when that total plus the atom still fits in the allowance. An atom that would pass the allowance is left out, and the scan stops. The tail is then placed in ascending message order. The result order is the pin, then the head, then the tail, then the live line. The token sum adds every piece in that result, including the live line.
      Parameters:
      managedTokens - The allowance is the token limit. Zero or less returns null.
      pieces - The pieces are the stored turns and at most one live line.
      Returns:
      The transcript is the selection, or null when the selection is refused.
